user_prompt: What is the effect of galantamine 16 to 24 mg/day (8 to 12 mg twice daily), compared with placebo, on cognitive function (ADAS-cog change from baseline at 6 months) in people with Alzheimer's disease?  This is specifically the 16-24 mg/day (regular release) dose arm — not the 8 mg/day, the prolonged-release 16-24 mg/day, or the 32 mg/day arms, which are separate dose subgroups in this review. Two of the trials here (Tariot 2000, Brodaty 2005) tested multiple galantamine doses against one shared placebo group — extract only this specific dose arm's data against that shared placebo, not the other dose arm from the same trial.  Pool as a Mean Difference (MD), since all studies use the same ADAS-cog instrument.
